operations.title: Four-site incidence now requires an upstream triangulation derivation
operations.body: Entry 1158 (event 900) audits the primary source. arXiv:2408.16386 explicitly freezes only the two- and three-site applications. It gives the all-graph q_g/canonical-function machinery, but no explicit four-site signed-triangulation term or simultaneous denominator subset. Therefore Entry 1157 cannot yet be assembled into a physical Cech complex. The admissible next move is upstream derivation from arXiv:1709.02813 / 2112.09028 / 2005.03612, not a symmetry-fitted C4 subset.
